notes:
Pilot: from martial-arts (class pattern). It already books children through a parent or guardian, has a free first visit with nothing taken (here the tour), a paid-in-full single visit (here the drop-in day), plans with their own yes on the secure page, forms on the secure page and a pick-up list. What it lacked was added: age rooms with a child-to-teacher limit, a waitlist with offers, enrollment forms with health and shot records, drop-off and pick-up with photo ID, a parent late for pick-up, and monthly tuition billed on the 1st.
Names: Sam Lee's main company is Lee Kids Events LLC (event care and babysitting, registration EX-1042, 90 Hill Rd); his second company is Lee Early Learning LLC (the center, license EX-2098, 560 Juniper St). The master's shape is kept: flow A is at the center, flow B at Lee Kids Events. ID numbers start with EX- so they read as made up.
People: at the center Tasha (Twos room lead) and Mei (preschool and infants), with Pat the office manager; at events Hana and Ruth, always two teachers. Alex is 'Alex' or 'they', never 'he'; Hana, Ruth, Tasha and Mei are 'she'; Sam stays 'he'.
Money paths, flow A: list|deposit|none is the main path, a place: the $100 registration fee and a $300 deposit at booking (the deposit counts toward the first month), the $980 rest of November charged at 11am the business day before, then monthly tuition as a plan with its own yes. list|none|counter is the free tour: nothing taken, nothing owed at the desk. list|full|none is a drop-in or backup day, $85 paid in full, forms already on file.
Money paths, flow B: list|card|card is the main path, a kids' room at a family's home: $40 an hour for each teacher, a card saved only for the $80 late-cancel or no-show fee, the hours given charged at DONE. list|none|bill is a workplace kids' room: nothing taken, billed after. Not listed: holds, deposits in B, photo or visit quotes (every price comes from the list), the business's own way.
Rosfield's $2: once per booking, as the brief says: a place counts once, not each day or month, and a kids' room counts once whatever its hours or teachers. The master's plan wording says a repeating plan counts once a month; I followed the brief and flag it. A tour that happens counts like any confirmed booking (the master's rule); a missed or cancelled tour doesn't.
